title: Episode title — NTSB Fires Back at the Times, a Pilot's Cocaine Problem, and BA Hits the Runway Twice
summary: The NTSB goes to war with the New York Times over a safety story it says is political hit job dressed up as journalism. Plus, an American Airlines pilot is in a UK jail cell after allegedly trying to fly high on cocaine, a British Airways A321neo smacks its tail on the runway not once but twice on live TV, and KLM decides the way to save money is to fly smaller planes — which is the opposite of what everyone else is doing.
